lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK, so you go get the, the seat and then what do you do?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: ..... the big pit fire and then we got there and threw it on it

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: During this process, is he moving the rake, shoveling it to mix things up and stir things?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: So then after you throw the seat on, what happens, when do you see the body parts?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Like when he's pushing it on there.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK. Tell me again what do you see in that fire?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: First you see the feet? And then what?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Then I looked around a little bit and I seen ..............

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: You saw the hands and the forehead. And then what did you see?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: So you went and got some wood, came back and he ... then what did you see?
